hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS" = "1" ] && exit 0; osascript -e "display notification \"Claude Code has finished its task.\" with title \"Task Completed\""
[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS" = "1" ] && exit 0; osascript -e "display notification \"Claude Code needs your permission to proceed.\" with title \"User Input Required\""

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); branch=$(git -C "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'no repo'); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); echo "${branch}${remaining:+ | ${remaining}% ctx left}"
